title: Follow an invitation into a waiting campaign
description: An independent new commander follows an invitation through authentication and saved identity, reviews a faction and claims a real seat. The host observes the acknowledged roster change. The starting host campaign is prepared through ordinary UI with fixed catalogue entropy and explicit development access.

steps.description: Prepare the host's saved identity and one-seat waiting campaign through real sign-in/create/join UI. Grant emulator development access; the test-only loader fixes catalogue entropy, not keys, commands or persistence.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Open the invitation while signed out.
steps.acknowledgement: Sign-in is required before campaign access.
verifications: The private galaxy is not exposed before authentication.

steps.description: Continue to entry with the invitation preserved.
verifications: Entry preserves the exact invited campaign ID.

steps.description: Authenticate and reach first-time identity editing.
steps.acknowledgement: The commander name field is ready.
verifications: No identity command is submitted by sign-in alone.

steps.description: Grant this authenticated emulator account development access so it can enter the explicitly development-only campaign; this is not public admission approval.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Choose the identity used for this campaign.
steps.acknowledgement: The local identity choice is retained.
verifications: The draft remains unsent until Save.

steps.description: Save the identity and resume the exact invitation automatically.
steps.acknowledgement: The invited campaign opens faction selection after identity acceptance.
verifications: Exactly one saved identity revision exists and the editor has closed.

steps.description: Review the Pelagic faction before claiming the seat.
steps.acknowledgement: Pelagic is selected and the commitment stays available.

steps.description: Commit the selected seat and wait for the host's authoritative roster update.
steps.acknowledgement: The server confirms the new seat and the host sees the invited commander.
verifications: The guest sees the actual galaxy without creating another identity revision.

steps.description: Reload and recover the admitted campaign without re-saving identity.
verifications: The campaign URL and original identity revision are unchanged.
